fields.System.Title: FDN-504 — Bulk import locations
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a system administrator setting up a warehouse, I want to load thousands of locations
from a file, so that I do not create four thousand racking positions by hand.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a valid file, when I import it, then every location is created.
  • - Given a file with any invalid row, then nothing is imported and every problem is
  • reported at once, with row numbers.
  • - Given a row referencing a zone that does not exist, then it is reported as invalid.
  • - Given duplicate codes within the file, then they are reported as invalid.
  • - Given a row with a missing capacity or sequence, then it is reported as invalid.
  • - Given a file that has already been imported, then re-importing it changes nothing.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | masterdata |
| Tables | location |
| Risks | Partial import leaves an unclear half-populated set ([doc 09 §11.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · idempotency |
